These paired synthetic FASTQs contain 400 reads per mate, Illumina-style tile
identifiers, duplicated sequences, adapter content, Ns, and varying read lengths
and qualities. They are test inputs, not biological research data.

The two `*_fastqc` directories contain **unmodified actual output** generated by
FastQC v0.13.0 with Java 17 on 2026-10-15. The supplied limits file is FastQC's
default configuration with `kmer ignore 0`, enabling the optional K-mer module.
All 12 supported modules are present, with actual PASS/WARN/FAIL classifications.
Do not edit the reported values to satisfy a test.

Reproduce (from the repository root; choose a new output directory):

```sh
mkdir -p /tmp/qualidock-fixture-recheck
fastqc --threads 1 --memory 512 \
  --limits backend/tests/fixtures/fastqc-0.13.0/limits.txt \
  --outdir /tmp/qualidock-fixture-recheck \
  backend/tests/fixtures/fastqc-0.13.0/coverage_R{1,2}.fastq.gz
```

No K-mer calculation is implemented in QualiDock. Normal application runs use
the installed FastQC configuration; absent optional modules remain unavailable.
